pages.text: Allows to create $(l:utility/grasses_dye)Dye$(), set color on $(l:utility/dyeing_tool)Dyeing Tool$() and $(l:utility/dyeing_bone_meal)Dyeing Bone Meal$().$(br2)In the chapter $(l:colors_ingredients_list_category)Colors and Ingredients$() you can read the list of ingredients used to obtain a specific color.$(br)
